Thanks for the ping. High-level checklist I'll use on the call:

1) Clarify the QPS numbers: steady vs burst; request concurrency distribution; any scheduled fan-out.
2) Input/output token lengths per request (median, 95th).
3) Acceptable latency SLOs by route (batch vs interactive).
4) Failure modes and fallback policy (e.g., synchronous vs queued).
5) Data residency/KMS requirements (so we don't suggest cloud-only autoscale that violates policy).
6) Whether you want prefix/KV caching for repeated user prompts (lowers cost + latency).

If p90=120ms is strict, we may recommend a smaller model family with more GPUs and lower batch sizes, or quantized replicas with dedicated routing. I'm fine with a 30–45 minute slot to run through the profile and propose an initial capacity sketch. Cynthia — does 4/21 3:00 PM PT (30–45 min) work for you? I'll prepare a short slide with expected throughput curves and a few configuration options.
